What to Know About The Supermoon Appearing This Thanksgiving Week

There will be a lot of things competing for your attention this Thanksgiving week: the travel, the turkey , the family, the football. But spare a moment for the sky. On Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday, Nov. 23 to 25, a spectacular full moon known as a supermoon will shine overhead, visible both in the evening and, though not as dazzlingly, during the day.
